problem: Heavy self-hosted proofs can rebuild unchanged native dependencies or rerun unchanged runtime proof after documentation, Python, asset or proof-orchestration edits, wasting runner time and increasing machine load.
invariant: Separate STATIC, RUNTIME and COMPILE evidence, then split COMPILE into WARM and COLD. Hash binary-contract inputs into a compile fingerprint and proof inputs into a proof fingerprint. With matching engine/toolchain provenance, a source/build-graph fingerprint change preserves trusted Binaries/Intermediate and delegates minimal outdated-action selection to the native build system. Purge only when cache provenance is missing/malformed or the build environment drifts. Reuse runtime proof only when its fingerprint also matches, while emitting fresh exact-revision equivalence evidence.
evidence: YACS PR #288 measured a roughly 20-minute cold-ish PCGEx/Editor build and proved fingerprinted compile reuse
YACS Issue #289 generalizes STATIC/RUNTIME/COMPILE and WARM/COLD compilation to normal code-only Unreal CI
docs/CI_VALIDATION_TIERS.md defines fail-closed warm build-state reuse
do_not_copy: Passo Giau paths, camera coordinates or proof variant names
failure_behavior: Unknown runtime-sensitive inputs force COMPILE. Missing/malformed cache state or engine/toolchain drift forces COLD and purges build outputs. Compile-fingerprint mismatch, previous compile failure, or missing final binaries forces WARM: invalidate the green lease but retain trusted intermediates so the native build system can rebuild/relink only what is outdated. Proof-only mismatch permits RUNTIME with verified binaries but never skips Automation. STATIC requires exact-head checkout plus full compile/proof equivalence checks.
